notes: Imd6900 is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender. It has no administrative privileges, transfer fees, or external mint function. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool uses the specified paired token, a 0.3% fee, and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), expressed with Imd6900 as currency0. The deployer derives the actual opening price from the economics and totalSupply using the deployed currencies' address ordering.
